DevOps Engineer graduate from ENIT with hands-on experience in
Cloud Computing, CI/CD, and Kubernetes.
Skilled in designing cloud-native architectures on GCP, building

Strong foundation in infrastructure automation, observability.

accelerate software innovation.

During my internship at Primatec Engineering, I worked in a team of four using
the Scrum methodology to tackle automation and optimization tasks related to
automotive software development. Our focus was on improving processes for
engineers working on Electronic Control Units (ECUs) for clients like BMW and
Volkswagen.
I developed a Python script using GitLab's API to automate the creation of
feature branches and merge requests in GitLab projects following the GitFlow
methodology, including handling submodules.
Additionally, I contributed to creating a file comparison tool to assist engineers
in identifying updates between different versions of descriptive files used
to develop the application layer of ECUs. This tool automatically highlights
added, removed, and modified lines between the client’s new and previous file
versions, helping to save time and reduce human error.
